title: The Polygon Garden Where All Creatures Learn Their Shapes

features.name: eleven-fold bird
features.desc-on-touch: a creature composed of eleven perfect sides, each one containing the whole bird. you see the platonic form of all seagulls at once.

features.name: geometric tide pool
features.desc-on-touch: creatures surface here to discover themselves. the pool is a mirror where every shape learns what it truly is.

features.name: ascending wireframe
features.desc-on-touch: creatures climbing toward their own geometry. each step reveals another side of what they are.

features.name: tessellation grove
features.desc-on-touch: shapes that fit together perfectly, each one complete, none leaving space for anything imperfect. here, all creatures find their fit.

features.name: glyph-temple of form
features.desc-on-touch: inscriptions in pure geometry. the names of all creatures written as the number of sides they possess.

features.name: reflection tower
features.desc-on-touch: inverted creatures looking up from geometric sand. each reflection teaches the creature above who it is.

inscription: every creature here has learned its true shape—the number of sides it was always meant to have

file.name: Beach_Platonic_Forms_Catalogue_Unsigned.txt
file.note: a registry of which creatures render as which polygons, and what happens when a creature discovers it has been imperfectly itself all along

exits.label: back down the beach toward the seagulls in their true forms
